nom: ICONIC LONDON Underglow Matcha Melting Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I love this balm 💚 it feels really nice on my skin and knowing my face is clean but I don't feel it dry is the most perfect thing. I love the packaging, very kbeauty inspired and def convenient to know how much to use
I hove how it cleanses but also acts as a makeup remover taking every bit of makeup on my face!!!! it feels nourishing and soft on my skin! I can't get enough!

Every since i got this a few weeks ago, it has completely taken over my nightime routine! Not only is the packaging hygienic and aesthetic, the formula effectively takes off all my makeup and spf without leaving a film like some other balms do. LOVE!

I would love to leave a glowing review for this product, as I do like this brand overall. However, the packaging on this product completely fell apart, forcing me to remove the product from this component, and put it into something else. Therefore, I cannot use the grinding mechanism as designed. For whatever reason, each time I removed the lid, the entire component would fall apart into three pieces, and would not 'lock' back together no matter what I tried. It had already been 30 days since purchase when this happened and honestly, not even worth the hassle of the return/exchange. The product itself is nothing special or perhaps I would have made more of an effort. Will definitely NOT repurchase.
